This form is used to identify the valid users of an application. The
user should be identified by his/her OPS$ account, e.g., OPS$USER.
This form is also used to define the user's access privileges to the system.
For each FCN_GRP defined for the application, the user may be assigned
an access level from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest). The user will only be
able to see an execute those menu selections for which his/her access level
matches or exceeds the level assigned for that FCN_GRP.

Item.Name: DRIVE_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter Drive Date in MMDDYYYY format

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp boolean;
 errstring varchar2(50);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 enter;
 if not form_success then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 check_package_failure;

 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.drive_access is not null then
 If :ctrl_block_1.drive_date > (trunc(chp_sysdate) + 1) then
 show_error('21126');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 next_item;
 :ctrl_block_1.c_day := to_char(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date, 'Day');
 temp := show_lov('LOV_DRIVES');
 End If;
 
 ELSE
 If :ctrl_block_1.drive_date not between (trunc(chp_sysdate) - 1) and (trunc(chp_sysdate) + 1) then
 errstring := to_char(chp_sysdate - 1, 'mm-dd-yyyy') || ' or ' ||
 to_char(chp_sysdate, 'mm-dd-yyyy') || ' or ' ||
 to_char(chp_sysdate + 1, 'mm-dd-yyyy');
 
 show_error('21029', ' ' || errstring);
 pause;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 Else
 next_item;
 :ctrl_block_1.c_day := to_char(:ctrl_block_1.drive_date, 'Day');
 temp := show_lov('LOV_DRIVES');
 End if;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN value_error then
 null;
 WHEN others then
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;

 --get the user access class

 select access_class into :GLOBAL.drive_access from valid_user_access_classes where

 -- IM 712

exception

END;
